title: Annotatio VI §.III: Bergen Fathers already — Rejicimus (non damnamus) four election errors (Art. XI Negativa)
pass_a_gloss: Something of this kind was already then done by the Bergen Fathers themselves in the Negative of Article XI, when they write thus: We therefore reject (but do not damn) all the errors we shall now enumerate: (1.) That God does not will that all men do repentance and believe the Gospel. (2.) That when God calls us to Himself, He does not seriously will that all men come to Him. (3.) That God does not will that all be saved, but that some are destined to destruction not by reason of their sins but by God’s Counsel, purpose and Will alone, so that they cannot obtain Salvation at all. (4.) That not God’s Mercy alone and Christ’s most Holy Merit, but also some Cause in ourselves, is of Divine Election, by reason of which Cause God elected us to eternal life. p. m. 591.
pass_b_english: The Bergen Fathers already did something like this in the Negative of Article XI.

They write: We therefore reject (but do not damn) all the errors we shall now list — that God does not will all to repent and believe; that His call is not serious for all; that some are doomed by bare counsel apart from their sins; that election’s cause lies partly in us, not only in God’s mercy and Christ’s merit (p. m. 591).
source_text: Factum jam tùm hujusmodi quid ab ipsis Patribus Bergensibus in Negativa Artic. XImi, quando ita scribunt: Rejicimus itaque (non autem damnamus) omnes, quos jam enumerabimus errores: (1.) Quòd Deus nolit, ut omnes homines paenitentiam agant & Evangelio credant. (2.) Quando DEus nos ad se vocat, quod non serio hoc velit, ut omnes homines ad ipsum veniant. (3.) DEum non velle, ut omnes salventur, sed quosdam, non ratione peccatorum suorum, verùm solô Dei Consilio, proposito & Voluntate ad exitium destinatos esse, ut prorsus Salutem consequi non possint. (4.) Quod non sola DEi Misericordia & Sanctissimum Christi Meritum; sed etiam in nobis ipsis aliqua Causa sit Electionis Divinae, cujus Causae ratione Deus nos ad vitam aeternam elegerit. p. m. 591.

choices.english: we reject … we do not damn

notes: Bergen Art. XI Negativa; Rejicimus non damnamus; four election errors.
